items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Had Anita left by then? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah, she'd been gone.

ctx.x: Metropolitan Ballroom in Philadelphia. That's where I broke with the band. I couldn't make it. Every night, a different cat would pick me to follow me home. "How come you don't give me more solos?" I said, "You didn't play no more than that when Gene was here." Because I used to run the band when Gene was there, when he'd go out or something like that. I played the drums, too, you know. So I said, "Man, this ain't for me." No, it was too much, man.

Oh yeah, she'd been gone. Dolores Hawkins was there. And after Dolores left, there was another girl who joined. I think her old man used to play the saxophone or something. Gloria...Gloria...Gloria something. It wasn't Gloria Lynne; that's a Black singer.
